name: Authentication activity for the user
purpose: Show successes and failures around the finding to confirm account takeover or brute force.
spl: index=* (`cim_authentication_indexes`) sourcetype=* user="$user$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | eval result=coalesce(action, status, result) | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user, src, dest, result | sort -count

name: Failed logons followed by success
purpose: Classic brute-force / password-spray evidence for the same user or source.
spl: index=* (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624 OR action=failure OR action=success) user="$user$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | bin _time span=5m | stats count(eval(EventCode=4625 OR action=failure)) as failures count(eval(EventCode=4624 OR action=success)) as successes by _time, user, src | where failures>5 AND successes>0

name: Network traffic between source and destination
purpose: Confirm the connection, volume, ports, and whether the dest is rare for this src.
spl: index=* (`cim_network_traffic_indexes`) src="$src_ip$" dest="$dest_ip$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count sum(bytes) as bytes sum(bytes_out) as bytes_out dc(dest_port) as ports by src, dest, dest_port, transport | sort -bytes

name: Is this destination rare for the source?
purpose: First-seen / rare destinations increase C2 and exfil confidence.
spl: index=* src="$src_ip$" dest="$dest_ip$" earliest=-30d latest=$latest$ | stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen count by src, dest | eval first_seen_in_window=if(first_seen>=strptime("$earliest$","%m/%d/%Y:%H:%M:%S"),1,0)

name: DNS lookups for the domain
purpose: See who queried the domain, how often, and whether it is newly seen.
spl: index=* (sourcetype=*dns* OR sourcetype=stream:dns) query="$domain$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count dc(src) as srcs values(src) as srcs_sample by query, query_type, reply_code | sort -count

name: Proxy / web access to the URL or domain
purpose: User-agent, status, and bytes for the suspected URL.
spl: index=* (`cim_web_indexes`) url="$url$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count values(status) as status values(http_user_agent) as ua sum(bytes) as bytes by src, user, url, dest

name: Web requests to the domain
purpose: Broader than the exact URL: every request to the suspected domain.
spl: index=* (`cim_web_indexes`) (url="*$domain$*" OR dest="$domain$") earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count dc(url) as urls sum(bytes) as bytes by src, user, dest

name: Process execution on the host
purpose: Confirm the process, parent, and command line on the impacted endpoint.
spl: index=* (`cim_endpoint_indexes`) (host="$src$" OR dest="$dest$" OR src="$src$") process_name="$process$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count values(parent_process_name) as parents values(user) as users dc(command_line) as cmds by dest, process_name | sort -count

name: Encoded or suspicious command lines
purpose: Catch encoded PowerShell, rundll32, and LOLBins around the finding.
spl: (index=* host="$src$" OR dest="$src$") earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ (powershell OR cmd.exe OR rundll32 OR mshta OR wscript OR cscript OR pwsh) (EncodedCommand OR -enc OR -nop OR FromBase64String OR IEX OR Invoke-Expression OR DownloadString) | table _time, host, user, process_name, parent_process_name, command_line

name: File hash prevalence
purpose: First-seen hashes and low-prevalence files are stronger malware evidence.
spl: index=* (file_hash="$file_hash$" OR sha256="$file_hash$" OR sha1="$file_hash$" OR md5="$file_hash$") earliest=-30d latest=$latest$ | stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen dc(dest) as hosts values(file_name) as names count

name: Email delivery for the user
purpose: Phishing delivery evidence: sender, subject, attachments, URLs.
spl: index=* (`cim_email_indexes`) (recipient="$user$" OR src_user="$user$" OR user="$user$") earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count values(subject) as subjects values(src_user) as senders values(url) as urls by recipient

name: Threat intelligence match on entities
purpose: Check ES threat intel / threat activity for IPs, domains, hashes, and URLs.
spl: | from datamodel:"Threat_Intelligence.Threat_Activity" | search threat_match_value IN ("$src_ip$","$dest_ip$","$domain$","$url$","$file_hash$","$threat_object$") | stats count values(threat_collection) as collections values(threat_category) as categories by threat_match_value, threat_match_field

name: Related ES findings for the entity
purpose: Corroborate with other findings / notables on the same user, host, or threat object.
spl: index=notable (user="$user$" OR src="$src$" OR dest="$dest$" OR risk_object="$risk_object$" OR threat_object="$threat_object$") earliest=-7d latest=$latest$ | search event_id!="$finding_id$" | stats count dc(rule_name) as detections values(rule_title) as titles max(urgency) as urgency by user, src, dest | sort -count

name: Intermediate findings (risk events) for the entity
purpose: RBA context: contributing intermediate findings and risk score trend.
spl: index=risk risk_object="$risk_object$" earliest=-7d latest=$latest$ | stats sum(risk_score) as risk_score dc(source) as detections values(risk_message) as messages by risk_object, risk_object_type | sort -risk_score

name: Asset lookup for involved hosts
purpose: Owner, category, priority, and whether the asset is a DC / crown jewel.
spl: | inputlookup append=t asset_lookup_by_str where ip="$dest$" OR nt_host="$dest$" OR dns="$dest$" | append [| inputlookup asset_lookup_by_str where ip="$src$" OR nt_host="$src$"] | table ip, nt_host, dns, owner, priority, category, bunit, lat, long

name: Identity lookup for the user
purpose: Watchlist, privileged, executive, and category flags from ES identities.
spl: | inputlookup identity_lookup_expanded where identity="$user$" OR nick="$user$" OR email="$user$" | table identity, first, last, email, category, watchlist, priority, bunit, phone

name: Windows process creation (4688 / Sysmon 1)
purpose: Full process tree on the host during the window.
spl: index=* (EventCode=4688 OR EventCode=1) (host="$src$" OR dest="$src$" OR Computer="$src$") earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | table _time, host, user, process_name, parent_process_name, command_line | sort _time

name: Network logons (possible lateral movement)
purpose: Type 3 / type 10 logons from the source onto other hosts.
spl: index=* EventCode=4624 (Logon_Type=3 OR Logon_Type=10 OR LogonType=3 OR LogonType=10) src="$src_ip$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count dc(dest) as dests values(dest) as dest_sample values(user) as users by src, Logon_Type | sort -dests

name: Large outbound transfer from the source
purpose: Exfiltration evidence: unusual bytes out in the window.
spl: index=* (`cim_network_traffic_indexes`) src="$src_ip$" earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats sum(bytes_out) as bytes_out dc(dest) as dests by src, dest | where bytes_out>5000000 | sort -bytes_out

name: Authentication geography for the user
purpose: Impossible travel / new country evidence.
spl: index=* user="$user$" (action=success OR EventCode=4624 OR sourcetype=*noninteractive*) earliest=-24h latest=$latest$ | iplocation src | stats dc(Country) as countries values(Country) as country_list values(City) as cities dc(src) as srcs by user | where countries>=2

name: Endpoint security alerts on the host
purpose: Corroborate with CrowdStrike / Defender / ES endpoint detections.
spl: index=* (sourcetype=crowdstrike:* OR sourcetype=ms:defender:* OR sourcetype=*sysmon*) (ComputerName="$src$" OR host="$src$" OR dest="$src$") earliest=$earliest$ latest=$latest$ | stats count values(event_simpleName) as events values(DetectName) as detects by host, user

name: Triage agent / investigation notes
purpose: Pull notes attached to the finding, including Triage agent analysis text.
spl: | rest splunk_server=local "/servicesNS/nobody/missioncontrol/public/v2/findings/$finding_id$/notes?search_format=true" | table id, created, author, body
